M-LOCUS-MODEL.Summary: The Locus, Charter, Relation and Fabric model with Identity checks and deep freezing.

M-LOCUS-VALIDATION.Summary: Validates a Fabric into an ordered list of diagnostics with stable codes.

M-LOCUS-REVISION.Summary: Canonical form, content-addressed Revisions and ordered change sets between two Revisions.

M-LOCUS-HISTORY.Summary: The RevisionHistory service with compare-and-set append and an in-memory layer.

M-LOCUS-DECODE.Summary: Decodes unknown or JSON text input into Fabric and Locus definitions with path-located issues.

M-LOCUS-SPECS.Summary: The executable specification catalogue, its runner, the playground examples and Revision goldens, served from the @telos/locus/specs entry point.
